dSEX3.justification: The old cap was inherited from a different export and clip. Region analysis found a 12px shifted header title (894 excess pixels), now corrected and independently probed. Remaining pixels come from Figtree glyph/weight rasterization, the omitted back glyph (no predecessor action on this route), and the native rounded search border's one-pixel edge pattern. Search bounds, 52px targets, progress and action order are independently probed. No masks, geometry tolerances, or locale allowances were added. The 5.4% cap leaves about 290 pixels over the measured aligned capture.
